description:
Sign a raw 32-byte digest with Schnorr (BIP-340) using the wallet's Taproot private key. Use for Taproot script-path spending, multisig coordination, or any case where you need a BIP-340 Schnorr signature over a pre-computed hash (e.g., BIP-341 sighash). WARNING: This signs raw digests that cannot be human-verified — use confirmBlindSign=true after reviewing the digest. Returns a 64-byte signature and the x-only public key. Requires an unlocked wallet.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

auxRand.description: Optional 32-byte hex auxiliary randomness for BIP-340 (improves side-channel resistance)

confirmBlindSign.description: Set to true to confirm you have reviewed the digest and accept the risk of signing a raw hash. Default is false, which returns a warning with the digest for review before signing.

digest.description: 32-byte hex-encoded digest to sign (e.g., BIP-341 transaction sighash)

name: schnorr_sign_digest
